currency_value_convention: All values are constant USD2041 purchasing-power equivalents in the established U accounting convention; nominal U faces and constituent exchange rates remain unspecified. No Earth currency peg or reserve basket is adopted.
constituent_rule: Illustrative value allocation of one money total and every sector U-denominated financial asset/liability across U-related constituent currencies. No additional basket money or claims are added. Common weights are reporting scenarios, not measured exposures, exchange rates or an adopted currency constitution.
household_closure: Net saving applies to identified resident payroll, including construction and preopening work. The unretained part is assigned to outside consumption/services in this bounded closure; local secondary income, taxes, migration wealth and additional household borrowing are not invented. Voluntary contributions to a collective fund reduce household savings; no additional household beneficiary security is issued.
reserve_ownership: Enterprises retain a restricted claim on a reserve institution; the institution holds matching outside assets. This does not transfer beneficial ownership of the programme reserve to the public sector.
valuation_rule: Constructed physical assets use remaining-service replacement-value proxies plus construction WIP. Productive IP, unallocated commercial packages, natural resources and circulating material inventories remain unvalued. Own-funds shares and finite-horizon cash-claim quotes are reported separately, never added as real assets.
ownership_rule: Outside investors meet all baseline capital calls. New calls dilute local stakes at the disclosed own-funds convention. Transfers and purchases change rights to the same payout, not total programme cash. Purchases require no remaining modelled capital calls; negotiated vesting transfers rights without consideration and therefore records an outside capital transfer.
monetary_rule: Deposit holdings follow explicit retention/adoption assumptions. Domestic loan creation/repayment, restricted funding, custody, retained bank income and net external backing are reconciled annually. Outside-held supplier U term claims are financing, not transaction money. Price or exchange-rate equilibrium is not solved.
outside_counterparty_rule: Outside actors contain only claims against or held by off-Earth actors. Their reported positions are not complete outside-investor net worth. Dated capital contributions, payouts and buyout receipts are reported separately; disposition of other outside wealth remains unspecified.
community_retention_rule: Community funds retain all allocated payouts at zero real yield, alongside zero-yield household savings. Public spending and beneficiary distributions would reduce these stocks; the case is accumulation capacity, not an adopted spending policy.
